Allegations of donation theft at Madhya Pradesh's Baglamukhi temple

Following allegations of donation irregularities at the Baglamukhi temple in Madhya Pradesh, a three-member inquiry committee has been formed. The committee was tasked with investigating complaints from devotees regarding the alleged theft of silver, jewelry, and cash. The temple's non-governmental committee has denied the accusations, stating they are not responsible for the devotees' gold and silver.
